title: Resolve project and archive versions by kind
summary: Define a catalog view that returns graph type, product namespace, version label, source commit, engine, and evidence status.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve BART v0.0.3 application release and candidate as separate entries.
Distinguish the Graphify HQ v0.0.8 toolkit from AlderVale and Lydite versioned docs and starter maps.
Retain the original archive locations and statuses.

evidence.claim: AlderVale uses v0.0.x labels for its README HQ archive independently of Graphify HQ kit versions.
